question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget be accepted as a sessions.list-backed builtin in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should this issue wait for a richer sessions.activity-style Gateway contract?
rationale: The issue is clear, but the durable source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Use the linked PR as the candidate UI solution, while requiring its review blockers and proof to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until a richer per-session activity API lands, then implement the widget against that stable contract.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing only after this issue's agent-status details are preserved there.

recommendation.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR as the candidate UI solution, while requiring its review blockers and proof to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: The main unresolved product/API question is whether the existing sessions.list contract is enough or the assigned per-session activity contract should land first.
